game.title: Avowed
game.blurb: First-person fantasy RPG from Obsidian Entertainment, set in the Living Lands, released 2025-02-18. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours (well under a full run). Genre: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Choices and Combat
chapters.summary: Persuasion, lies, violence, stealth, parries and gear.

notes: Backlog game, added from the docs/PLAN.md candidate list. No StrategyWiki page. avowed.fandom.com answers the API, with about 81 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Alabama" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2457220. 19 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter.
